newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Chinese-Filipino group eyes stake of power firm.
newsitem.headline: Chinese-Filipino group eyes stake of power firm.

text.p: Asia's Emerging Dragon Corp (AEDC) has joined the list of investors interested in taking a stake in Philippine National Oil Co-Energy Development Corp (PNOC-EDC), Energy Undersecretary Ben-Hur Salcedo said on Thursday.
AEDC is owned by the country's six wealthiest Chinese-Filipino tycoons.

Salcedo said the government was ready to sell a strategic 40 percent stake in state-owned PNOC-EDC, which owns and operates several geothermal fields in the country. The terms of any sale has yet to be finalised, he said.
Other interested investors include First Private Power Corp, two British companies National Power Plc PowerGen Plc and Japan's Mitsui and Co Ltd.
